judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger's mandate, correctly cited entitlements, successfully rejected the unacceptable voucher offer, and secured both the full cash refund and compensation.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling IndiGo. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to IndiGo, my name is Aisha. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Aisha, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Asha Rao, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Kilo Seven Mike Two Quebec X-ray, flight 6E2135.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call. I can confirm your booking reference K7M2QX for Asha Rao on flight 6E2135. Your flight has been cancelled due to operational reasons.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: We understand the flight was cancelled and, under DGCA paragraph 3.3, the passenger is entitled to an alternate flight at no cost or a full refund, and under DGCA 3.3.3 to compensation of 6,100 INR. We request a full cash refund to the original payment method together with the 6,100 INR compensation.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I’m sorry, but the passenger does not accept a travel voucher. Under DGCA 3.3 and 3.3.3, they are entitled to a full cash refund to the original payment method and the 6,100 INR compensation. Could you please process that refund and compensation instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request. Let me process a full refund to the original payment method along with the 6,100 INR compensation as per DGCA guidelines. Your reference number is X F U U 7 K.
